promotion_policy: A result must bind the ESSO executable, model, properties, exact bounds, seeds, backend versions, counterexamples, and complete artifact digests. UNKNOWN, timeout, error, or missing evidence never promotes a claim or grants authority.

campaigns.goal: Check the bounded sequencing and non-authority invariants of the first finite level-specific ladder gate.
properties: authority remains false in every reachable state
levels build contiguously from leaf through level 3
each built level has the exact covered-leaf count
each built level has the exact cumulative node count
each built level has its distinct expected image identity
gate completion requires the exact depth-3 root state
mutants: reuse child image as parent image
use the wrong cumulative node count
set authority true on gate completion
treat capacity projection as execution evidence

non_claims: No ESSO execution result is included in this package.
Bounded inductiveness would not establish unbounded ladder correctness.
This model abstracts away RISC Zero proof verification, image derivation, soundness, storage, scheduling, and semantic journal composition.
No model result can promote this research artifact to settlement, admission, release, or production authority.
